title: "DtMF" Hits 62nd Consecutive Week at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs; Madrid Residency Night 5 Tomorrow
detail: The Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart dated June 6, 2026 confirms Bad Bunny's 'DtMF' at No. 1 for its 62nd consecutive week — extending the all-time record it set and continues to build upon after surpassing Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee's 'Despacito' at week 57 (chart dated May 2, 2026). At 62 weeks, 'DtMF' has now reigned at No. 1 on Hot Latin Songs for nearly 15 months uninterrupted, a margin of more than five weeks beyond the previous record. The chart's Top 5 as of June 6 reflects total Bad Bunny dominance: 'DtMF' leads, with 'BAILE INOLVIDABLE,' 'NUEVAYoL,' 'EoO,' and 'VOY A LLeVARTE PA PR' also charting in the top 10. The chart performance accompanies the Madrid residency's ongoing second rest day (June 4–5) between Cluster 2 and Cluster 3. Night 5 at Riyadh Air Metropolitano is tomorrow — June 6, 2026 — opening the third back-to-back cluster (June 6–7). Through four sold-out nights, the residency has drawn 256,000+ fans. On June 5, continuing press coverage of Bad Bunny's role in Pixar's *Toy Story 5* (June 19) aired on multiple Latin entertainment outlets: Bad Bunny voices 'Pizza with Sunglasses,' a mysterious forgotten toy, recording both English and Spanish dialogue. Spotify monthly listeners held above 114M on sustained Madrid tour momentum.
